name: VolumePro Ray-Casting with Slice-by-Slice Processing
definition: A real-time volume rendering system that implements object-space ray-casting with parallel slice-by-slice processing to achieve high frame rates on PC class computers.
summary: VolumePro is specialized hardware that achieves real-time volume rendering by combining object-space ray-casting with parallel slice-by-slice processing to read each voxel exactly once per frame.
